text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as we get back to the academy, Air
Groove
and I bump into Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Suzuka. Are you heading out to
train?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just going on a quick jog to clear
my
head.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You always seem to be running. But I
suppose
that's simply who you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I joined you? I'm also
in the
mood for a light sprint.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. On the contrary, I
feel quite
refreshed. That's why I wish to
run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Would you mind, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... As long as I get to run, I don't
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite setting off together at a
reasonable
pace...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them speed across the finish
line at
the exact same time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As always, there's a bite to your running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who got really serious
halfway
though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Only because you got serious first.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, because I didn't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Very well. Shall we have a
rematch?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'll be going all out from the
start this
time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As will I. No holds barred!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As will I. No holds barred!
choice_data_list: Don't push yourselves too hard, you two...
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course. I wouldn't dream of it.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourselves too hard, you two...
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And neither would I. Ready, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm ready when you are.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ready... set...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the two end up racing multiple
times to
determine a winner, neither is
able to secure a
clear victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-why are you getting all worked up?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is just training. That's hardly
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, don't be so harsh. I'm a little
jealous.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Enough! Are we running or not?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the two end up racing multiple
times,
neither is able to secure a clear
victory.
